title: Grilled Arabian Lentil Patties with Italian Flair
description: A fusion of Italian and Arabian cuisines, these lentil patties are a flavorful and healthy twist on traditional Italian dishes. Serve on a crusty Italian roll or with a side of sautéed vegetables.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cooked lentils, chopped aromatic, olive oil, cumin, salt, and pepper.
Mix well with your hands until the ingredients are fully incorporated.
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a patty.
Grill the patties for 3-4 minutes per side, or until they are lightly charred and cooked through.
Serve the patties on a crusty Italian roll or with a side of sautéed vegetables.
Optional: top with your favorite sauce or cheese.
